references.title: Custom evaluation methodology and access disclosure

methodology.notes: Custom 1.x text submission at commit 4ce7c0397c1eb65c9bbe59aeacfe1ca44a1cd699 (pyproject version 1.0.1; not the exact v1.0.1 release tag). Complete banking_knowledge domain: 97 tasks, four independent trials each, BM25 retrieval. Agent service: intellisu-coder-pro (leaderboard name: intellisu). Both the user simulator and natural-language assertion judge use the internal intellisu-reasoning-pro service instead of the benchmark defaults. Original task policies, tools, prompts, evaluator rubric and Pass^k functions were retained. Agent/user temperature 0, max_tokens 32768; NL judge max_tokens 16384 with JSON response format. Request-level response caching was bypassed for independent trials. No correctness-based retries or omitted tasks. The service is hosted on the Bank of Jiangsu intranet; public model endpoints, weights, model developer information and internal implementation details are unavailable. Public method notes describe the setup, but authorized service access would be required to reproduce inference; please review whether this disclosure suffices for custom inclusion. Costs in USD are unverified and omitted; logged zeros must not be interpreted as measured dollar costs. Results cover only this text domain, not 2.0, voice or a multi-domain overall score. The linked archive retains packaging metadata dated 2026-10-20; this submission.json is the current leaderboard metadata, and trajectories/rewards are unchanged.

verification.details: All 97 canonical banking_knowledge tasks, exactly four distinct trials each (388 simulations), zero infrastructure errors. Saved model messages and rewards are retained; the public file uses metadata prepared for disclosure. Model name intellisu is a display alias for openai/intellisu-coder-pro; the user simulator identifier openai/intellisu-reasoning-pro is reported without the transport prefix. Dollar costs are omitted because unavailable.
